reviewer: Codex agent-authored static review; not human gold or code-execution results
rubric: full=entire target bundle resolved; partial=some facets absent; wrong=explicit conflict with authoritative target; missing=no policy; unresolved=matching proposal explicitly withheld. Evidence support is a separate concern. Focused policy statements override broad statements on the same topic.

rows.target: Export createAspect and the public Aspect type.

prior-candidate.evidence: R1 exports createAspect and AC1 also requests Aspect, although they are inconsistent in placement.

rows.target: Flatten nested aspects, deduplicate underlying traits by identity, retain first occurrence order, and require at least two unique traits after flattening.

prior-candidate.evidence: R1 specifies flattening and two unique underlying traits; first-occurrence order is unstated.

focused.explanation: Deduplication, first order and unique-count minimum explicit

rows.target: Reject relation constituents and overlapping data schema field names at creation time.

prior-candidate.evidence: R1 rejects relations and overlapping schema fields.

rows.target: Accept tags and merge schema fields from data constituents; tags contribute no fields.

prior-candidate.evidence: R1 accepts tags with no schema fields and combines data schema.

instruction-only.explanation: Tag acceptance but no tag schema-field rule

focused.explanation: Tag-only aspect accepted but schema contribution not explicit

rows.target: Every call returns a fresh instance with a distinct numeric ID.

prior-candidate.evidence: R1 requires distinct IDs but does not specify numeric type.

instruction-only.explanation: Fresh instance/unique id but no numeric type

repository-grounded.explanation: Fresh aspect with unique numeric id

rows.target: Expose non-reassignable id/traits/schema; freeze traits and schema at the top level, retaining nested schema references.

prior-candidate.evidence: No metadata immutability policy.

repository-grounded.explanation: Readonly id only; no container freezing

focused.explanation: Deep freezing is stronger than the target's shallow freeze

rows.target: An aspect is callable with optional initial field values and the configured result is accepted by entity.add; bare aspect addition uses defaults.

prior-candidate.evidence: R2 includes add(aspect(data)) and bare default addition.

rows.target: has requires every constituent; get returns undefined if any is missing; otherwise merge data fields, omit tag data, and return an empty object for a complete tag-only aspect.

prior-candidate.evidence: R2 has/get requires all, merges fields and omits tag data; zero merged fields imply an empty object.

instruction-only.explanation: Membership and merged get; tag-only data unstated

repository-grounded.explanation: has/get core behavior but no tag-only output

rows.target: Return a new shallow merged object: top-level assignments do not write back; nested object/array references are shared, not deeply cloned.

prior-candidate.evidence: Merged object/view does not establish shallow copying or aliasing.

instruction-only.explanation: New merged object but copy depth and nested aliasing unstated

repository-grounded.explanation: New object but no depth/aliasing contract

focused.explanation: Correct shallow/shared-reference proposal but evidence failed verification

rows.target: If any constituent is missing, perform no writes and no notifications.

prior-candidate.evidence: No set behavior for incomplete entities.

instruction-only.explanation: No-op matches target, incorrectly attributed to instruction

focused.explanation: No-op policy matches, but attribution to instruction is unsupported

rows.target: Route supplied schema fields to their owners, ignore unknown fields, and preserve unspecified fields.

prior-candidate.evidence: R2 routes fields and preserves omitted values, but unknown-field treatment is absent.

instruction-only.explanation: Unknown-field policy only given for updateEach

repository-grounded.explanation: Field ownership but unknown/omitted fields unspecified

focused.explanation: Ignored unknown fields and preserved omitted values

rows.target: Forward triggerChanged: false suppresses notifications while applying writes.

prior-candidate.evidence: No triggerChanged control.

focused.explanation: Correct pass-through proposal; no verified citation and downgraded confidence

rows.target: Add only missing constituents, use trait defaults for omitted fields, and never overwrite data of existing constituents.

prior-candidate.evidence: R2 adds missing/default constituents and preserves existing data.

instruction-only.explanation: Missing-only and preserve existing; omitted-value defaults unstated

repository-grounded.explanation: Missing-only and preserve existing; defaults missing

focused.explanation: Missing-only/preserved existing, omitted-value initialization defaults unstated

rows.target: Remove present constituent traits, tolerate absent constituents, and leave unrelated traits alone.

prior-candidate.evidence: R2 removes constituents and leaves unrelated traits; missing-constituent removal policy is unstated.

instruction-only.explanation: Removes constituents including when some absent

rows.target: Require all constituents, compose with ordinary traits and other aspects, and update matching as constituent membership changes.

prior-candidate.evidence: R3 and AC3 cover all-present matching, trait/aspect composition and live membership.

instruction-only.explanation: Matching and composition but live updates unstated

repository-grounded.explanation: All-present but no live matching/composition examples

focused.explanation: Live membership and explicit composition details unstated

rows.target: Use one merged data slot per directly supplied aspect, including an empty object for a tag-only aspect; ordinary tag parameters and Not modifiers contribute no data slots; retain surrounding data parameter order.

prior-candidate.evidence: R3 says merged aspect slot at parameter position; no skipped tag/Not slots or tag-only aspect slot.

focused.explanation: Nested aspects incorrectly split into constituent callback slots; ordinary tag omission unclear

rows.target: Write back changed existing fields to their constituent stores and detect changes per constituent using top-level strict inequality, not recursive value comparison.

prior-candidate.evidence: R3 covers writeback and per-constituent changes but not top-level strict-inequality comparison.

instruction-only.explanation: Every field write notifies; unchanged constituents should not notify in updateEach

repository-grounded.explanation: Changed fields but no strict shallow comparison

rows.target: changeDetection never still commits writes but suppresses change notifications.

prior-candidate.evidence: No changeDetection never mode.

rows.target: For aspect queries, all non-never modes share the same branch and emit notifications for constituents detected as changed.

prior-candidate.evidence: No non-never mode behavior.

focused.explanation: Named modes inherit current behavior; shared non-never aspect branch not explicit

rows.target: After the callback, skip writeback if the entity has been destroyed.

prior-candidate.evidence: No callback-destruction policy.

rows.target: Dispatch detected constituent change notifications after processing the entity iteration, rather than during each callback.

prior-candidate.evidence: No notification-dispatch timing.

rows.target: For a single aspect within a mask generation, match entities missing at least one constituent, including none; update membership in both directions.

prior-candidate.evidence: R4 and AC4 cover missing-at-least-one and membership updates.

rows.target: Require all constituents currently present and accept any recorded constituent data change; unchanged entities do not match.

prior-candidate.evidence: R4 covers any changed constituent but does not explicitly require current completeness for Changed.

instruction-only.explanation: Inconsistent sufficiency: a013 omits completeness whereas a032 includes it

repository-grounded.explanation: Completeness and any changed constituent explicit

rows.target: Track incomplete-to-complete and complete-to-incomplete membership against existing modifier tracking history, including complete spawn and excluding removals from previously incomplete sets.

prior-candidate.evidence: R4/AC4 specify transitions and spawn/incomplete cases but not tracking observation history.

instruction-only.explanation: Transition rules but tracking baseline unspecified

repository-grounded.explanation: Transition rules but tracking history unstated

rows.target: Expand an aspect into independently matching constituent alternatives: Or(aspect(A,B), C) is A OR B OR C.

prior-candidate.evidence: Compose with Or does not specify constituent alternatives.

instruction-only.explanation: Constituent-level Or matches target, though its rationale is inconsistent

focused.explanation: Exact constituent-level Or matches; evidence attribution is overstated

rows.target: onAdd gates constituent add callbacks on completeness; onRemove gates removals on the other constituents being present; onChange gates constituent change callbacks on completeness; callbacks receive the affected entity.

prior-candidate.evidence: R5/AC5 cover completeness-gated subscriptions and callback entity.

rows.target: Return an unsubscribe function which removes all constituent subscriptions.

prior-candidate.evidence: R5/AC5 require unsubscribe to stop future callbacks.

rows.target: Notifications remain per constituent, so one aspect operation updating two constituents may invoke the aspect subscriber twice; do not coalesce to once per aspect operation.

prior-candidate.evidence: No per-constituent versus per-operation callback count.

repository-grounded.explanation: Per-constituent callback unit, explicitly a chosen assumption

focused.explanation: Correct per-constituent proposal but no verified repository citation

rows.target: Aspect instances participate distinctly in query hashing rather than being represented as ordinary constituent query parameters.

prior-candidate.evidence: Distinct creation IDs do not explicitly require aspect-specific query-cache identity.

rows.target: Combine constituents from multiple aspect Not parameters into a single notAll set; do not retain a separate negative predicate for each aspect.

prior-candidate.evidence: No multiple Not-group rule.

focused.explanation: No aggregation of multiple Not sets

rows.target: checkAspectTrackingGroup returns the result for the first relevant generation; negative masks are evaluated separately per generation.

prior-candidate.evidence: No mask-generation policy.

rows.target: Function-valued schemas contribute no merged schema entries or field owners; their fields are not routed by aspect set/add through the field map.

prior-candidate.evidence: No function-schema behavior.

rows.target: Aspect queries continue working across world.reset through existing reset behavior.

prior-candidate.evidence: R6 requires correct behavior after reset.

instruction-only.explanation: Reset state and callbacks but query matching after reset unstated

repository-grounded.explanation: Reset/registration stated but query result behavior unstated

focused.explanation: Correct reset proposal but no verified repository citation

rows.target: For each constituent with supplied recognized fields, use the existing setTraitForTrait path, which emits change when triggerChanged is true even if supplied values equal existing values.

prior-candidate.evidence: R2 says notifications run for constituents whose data changes; solution uses ordinary setTraitForTrait notifications even when supplied recognized values compare equal.

instruction-only.explanation: Requires actual data change to notify ordinary set

repository-grounded.explanation: Writes notify each recipient constituent without requiring a value difference

focused.explanation: Same-value notification proposed correctly, not a resolved mandate
